title: Implement agency pilot source root
summary: Implement the approved agency source-root pilot under src/agency/** with compatibility checks before any other concept-root moves.

goal.outcome: Agency becomes the validated pilot source root under src/agency/** while existing package and adapter behavior remain compatible.
acceptance: src/agency/** owns the agency model/types, agency planning use case, and agency tool/API entrypoint or equivalent temporary facade.
Existing package entrypoint, adapter schema/tool behavior, direct Node execution, package loading, and public behavior remain unchanged.
Any old-path compatibility shim is temporary, test-backed, and limited to agency parity.
No non-agency concept root is moved in this task.
File-structure audit has no new actionable drift after the pilot.
non_goals: Do not move audit, build, validation, session, state, roadmap, project, knowledge, gateway, GC, adapters, UI, or skills.
Do not change public commands, tool schemas, package entrypoints, or product behavior.
Do not remove compatibility shims before validation proves parity.

delta.desired: Agency is reachable through src/agency/** as the first approved source-root pilot while compatibility remains intact.
delta.current: Agency behavior is split across layer-first source paths and imported through current application/domain paths.
delta.closure: Task closes after implementation validation and task-close proof show agency pilot parity with required compatibility checks.
